context: A teacher explains a founder's biography to students
purpose: Teach: 墓/姉妹/一旦/住み/弟子/創業/国々/中立

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は皆さんに、ある会社の創業者の生涯を紹介します。
lines.en: Today I'll introduce you all to the life of a certain company's founder.
lines.style: Teacher opening a lesson in calm formal classroom tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、その方はどこの出身だったんですか？
lines.en: Professor, where was that person originally from?
lines.style: University student asking a polite curious question

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 彼は若い頃、京都に住み込みで働きながら、有名な職人の弟子になりました。
lines.en: When he was young, he lived and worked in Kyoto and became the apprentice of a famous craftsman.
lines.style: Teacher narrating biographical history with measured pacing

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、最初から経営者だったわけじゃないんですね。
lines.en: Wow, so he wasn't a business owner from the start.
lines.style: Student expressing genuine surprise in casual reflective tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ。三十歳で一旦故郷に戻り、姉妹と一緒に小さな工房を始めました。
lines.en: Right. At thirty he temporarily returned home and started a small workshop together with his sisters.
lines.style: Teacher continuing the narrative with steady factual delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ご姉妹も創業メンバーだったんですか。すごいですね。
lines.en: His sisters were also founding members? That's impressive.
lines.style: Student responding with admiration and follow-up interest

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その後、戦争中も政治的に中立の立場を守り、アジアの国々に商品を広めていきました。
lines.en: After that, even during the war he maintained a politically neutral stance and spread his products to countries across Asia.
lines.style: Teacher emphasizing key historical achievement with respectful weight

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それは本当に立派ですね。お墓は今どちらにあるんでしょうか？
lines.en: That's truly admirable. Where is his grave located now?
lines.style: Student showing earnest respect and historical curiosity

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 京都の郊外にあります。命日には今でも社員の方々がお墓参りに行くそうですよ。
lines.en: It's in the outskirts of Kyoto. Apparently employees still visit his grave on the anniversary of his death.
lines.style: Teacher closing the story with warm reverent tone
